definitions.explanation: The outer covering of a book, magazine, or notebook, typically containing the title and sometimes an image.

examples.japanese: {表紙|ひょうし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{表紙|ひょうし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ボロボロ→ぼろぼろ：05164_boroboro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{雑誌|ざっし}→雑誌：00686_zasshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{表紙|ひょうし}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{俳優|はいゆう}→俳優：03547_haiyuu⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: A famous actor is on the cover of this magazine.

examples.english: You shouldn't judge a book by its cover.
The child liked the illustration on the cover and said they wanted to read the book.

notes:
USAGE: {表紙|ひょうし} refers specifically to the cover of bound materials like books and magazines.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {表紙|ひょうし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飾|かざ}る→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧ (to grace the cover)
- {表紙|ひょうし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{載|の}る→載る：27882_noru⟧ (to appear on the cover)
- {表紙|ひょうし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦めくる→捲る：02310_mekuru⟧ (to turn the cover)

COMPOUNDS:
- {表紙|ひょうし}⟦{絵|え}→絵：02613_e⟧ (cover illustration)
- {表紙|ひょうし}⟦モデル→モデル：05112_moderu⟧ (cover model)
- {表紙|ひょうし}⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧ (cover photo)
